POCSO Act It has been argued by learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
He would further submit that there was friendship between the appellant and the victim/prosecutrix and she had gone with him to his house and stayed there for 1  months.

He would next submit that the victim/prosecutrix is a consenting party and as per opinion of the doctor (MLC Report Ex-P/21A), no definite opinion can be given about rape or sexual activity as no fresh injury on the private parts of the victim.
He would next submit that prosecutrix and her parents have turned hostile and not supported the case of the prosecution.
The appellant is in jail since 26.3.2020, hence, he may be released on bail.
On the other hand, Smt. Madhunisha Singh, learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

She would further submit that the appellant on the pretext of marriage, enticed the minor girl, aged about 14 years and 01 month at the time of incident, took her to his home in motor cycle and kept her there for about 1  months and during this period he established physical relationship with her.
Hence, there is sufficient evidence against the appellant to connect him with crime in question.
Therefore, the appellant is not liable to be released on bail.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the records of the Court below.

Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, particularly considering the act of the appellant, who took the minor prosecutrix, below the age of 16 years, to his house, kept her for about 1  months and sexually exploited her on the pretext of marriage, we are of the considered opinion that it is not a fit case to suspend the jail sentences.
Accordingly, IA No. 1 of 2023 stands rejected.
Let the matter be listed for final hearing after six weeks.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (NK Chandravanshi) (Ramesh Sinha)
 Judge Chief Justice Bini Heeradhan @ Heeradhar Pawle vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28099135/
